rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a choice or selection.

example.english: There are lots of choices to pick from at this restaurant.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 hou2 do1 syun2 zaak6

rows.note: Use this for the option or item regarded as the best or chosen first.

example.english: This hotel is my first pick.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 sau2 syun2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when selecting one option from several.
Use this for removing fruit, vegetables, flowers, or similar things from where they are attached.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zaak6 si6 do1 be1 lei4

rows.note: Use this when picking up or gathering things from the ground or from different places.

example.english: I’ll pick up the papers on the floor for you.
example.jyutping: dei6 haa6 di1 zi2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 zap1 faan1

rows.note: Use this for picking or digging at something with the fingers, especially a scab or something lodged in a small space.

example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 kau1 bei6 si2
